summary: Ribbon Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing an OTC Equity Prepaid Forward Transaction with investor Meteora Select Trading Opportunities Master, LP. The forward purchase agreement—tied to its previously announced business combination with DRC Medicine Ltd.—commits the investor to purchase up to 4,100,000 PubCo common shares at the SPAC redemption price. The issuer pays a prepayment amount from its trust account, settles in cash six months post-closing based on VWAP, with a $1.00 per-share settlement adjustment. The transaction appears to be a SPAC-related financing/hedging arrangement rather than a standalone special situation. Watch future filings for the business combination's closing and pricing mechanics.
